title: A batch go checks open owner items on its lanes
why: Incident (coordinator 12:09 CST Nov 13): the 12:05 go on batch 136 (#3163) included #2829 while page item 730 was open; caught before merge.
note: Todo. Before a batch go, read the open owner items that name any lane or PR in the batch and hold that lane. Also a past-ruling slip: item 730 should have cited decision waiting-data-in-repo (triage posted it from the retrospective without that check; gap on past-ruling-on-send).
